people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
translations.bsb: but Israel, who pursued a law of righteousness, has not attained it.
translations.kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
translations.asv: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, did not arrive at that law.
